## Reasoning rendering
- Streaming reasoning is rendered as **plain text** while the model is still thinking and as Markdown only once the reasoning block actually finishes — no more flicker from re-parsing half-open fences and emphasis on every delta.

## bun 1.4.0 compatibility
- Fixed the test/runtime breakage under bun 1.4: the Solid JSX transform and the `solid-js` client-build redirect now load through a `[test] preload` entry and an explicit alias preload (the SSR build executed effects eagerly, producing "Orphan text error" from stray empty text nodes).
- The bun development pin is now 1.4.0 and the full suite runs green under it.
- The diff-header row reserves one cell so the scroll/collapse actions stay visible next to long clamped paths.

## pi-one-round-compaction integration
- Live **two-lane progress** (implementation/intent + evidence/execution, chars, state, elapsed) renders in the compaction panel while the extension compacts.
- The compacted-context card now understands the extension's `details` payload: parallel lanes and wall time, complete recent turns kept, whole-turn vs split-turn boundary, and file/git + intent-workflow state in the completion metadata.
